Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring employers to reimburse employees for work-related expenses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring employers to reimburse employees forwork-related expenses; and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An employer shall reimburse his or her employee for allnecessary business expenses incurred by the employee at the request ofthe employer and in direct consequence of the discharge of theemployee's duties. For the purposes of this section, "necessarybusiness expenses" may include expenses for the cost of cell phones,phone chargers, and other equipment. (2) If an employer does not reimburse the employee as requiredunder this section, the employee may bring a civil cause of action. Ifthe employee prevails, the court shall award the employee reasonableattorneys' fees and costs incurred to enforce this section. Awardscarry interest at the same rate as civil judgments under RCW 4.56.110.Interest accrues from the date on which the employee incurred the p. 1 HB 2230necessary business expense.
